about_the_game:
Well, would you look at that... turns out it wasn't just Sophie doing experiments on cats. This decidedly agile furry companion is ready to be adopted... or, is it the other way around? Would you like to be adopted by this lovely felinid? Just look at how cute she is...!

ABOUT CATHERINE

  • Age: 22

  • Height: 166cm

  • Blood: B

  • Bust size: B

  • Origin: Unknown

  • Interests: Chasing Things, Petting, Playtime

Discovered randomly during a patrol in the city, she followed them home... and stayed around. And, to be honest, you have no heart to get rid of this "stray", yourself. Of course you adopted her... Or did she adopt you...?

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

This DLC unlocks the legendary champion - Catherine, with 120 trust, enough to immediately reach level 10.

You will also receive an epic equipment set, allowing you to use her in missions immediately, along with a legendary look for Catherine (or its equivalent in nanites if you already have it).

And of course, by purchasing this DLC, you are supporting us. Thank you!
